text:
A white, box-shaped benchtop laboratory oven/drying cabinet fills most of the frame, standing upright on a pale surface against a light wall.

Its front door is closed, with a dark grey vertical bar handle on the left edge of the door. Set into the door is a square viewing window with rounded corners; the glass is tinted greenish-grey and reflective, showing faint reflections and an indistinct interior with what appear to be horizontal shelf edges.

At the left is a narrow control panel bearing Chinese labelling, a small dark digital display showing illuminated segments, a row of buttons beneath it, two green rocker switches, and a round black knob lower down. A further labelled plate sits near the panel's bottom.
